purpose: human readability follow-up; no answers prefilled or AI ratings
all_cases: seven previously fixed labeled frames; ten GT8-connected regions, not ten verified fish

discovery.assignment: balanced rotating3-cohort assignment; three observers cover three conditions at every frame; separate shuffled order per observer
discovery.limitation: one observer is an exploratory unpaired comparison; repeated frame versions deliberately avoided in discovery
discovery.display: 960x540 CSS pixels for1280x720 originals; no extra image zoom; record viewport and devicePixelRatio
discovery.response: found with source-coordinate click points / none / uncertain
discovery.scoring_if_done: maximum one-to-one matching to GT connected-component bounding boxes expanded8 source pixels; geometry proxy, not pixel recall or verified fish-instance recall

recognition.display: same240x180 source crop,480x360 CSS pixels; cue is a bounding rectangle, no GT silhouette
response: recognizable as fish with basic outline

order: all7 discovery tasks confirmed before any prompted crop; committed discovery answers cannot be rewritten after seeing cues
blinding: no method, real frame number, probability, PSNR, source path, or GT feedback in public tasks
exposure: record prior familiarity with these images/GT; prior-exposed discovery is not naive
saving: current draft autosaved; each confirm is durable; no final global-save button
reviewer_count: one is exploratory; independent extra observers optional; do not infer population significance
QA: separate QA answer directory and visible QA mode; never mixed into actual human results
